title: ONS Registry
description: Open OXEN Name System list, updated automatically from the blockchain. Easily lookup ONS names and get all authors usernames.

name_hashed.label: Hashed name
name_hashed.hint: We couldn't un-hash this name. It is probably something very unique. If you know what it is, type it to search and it will automatically be saved for other users.

value_encrypted.label: Encrypted SessionID
value_encrypted.hint: We couldn't un-hash this name, thus it's impossible to know whom it belongs to. If you know what it is, type it to search and it will automatically be saved for other users.

owner.label: Owner
owner.owner_type_wallet: Address of OXEN wallet that bought this ONS mapping

transaction.label: Transaction ID in OXEN blockchain
transaction.hint: Click to view transaction in OXEN blockchain explorer

updated_at_block.label: Block height
updated_at_block.hint: This ONS mapping was last updated at this block height
